market_pulse.note: About $65,373 Sunday morning, down 2.59% over 24 hours (TokenPost, 12:22 UTC), after touching $61,946 on Coinbase overnight, its lowest since July 13, and bouncing back above $65,000 within about 75 minutes (Coindaro).
About $1,803, down 5.31% over 24 hours (CoinCodex, 06:00 UTC), after an overnight low of $1,709 on Coinbase; ether is down 18.9% over seven days (Coindaro).
About $2.18 trillion, down 3.66% over 24 hours, with $99.1 billion in 24-hour trading volume (CoinCodex, 06:00 UTC).
About 59.5% of total crypto market value, little changed on the day (TokenPost; CoinCodex).

themes.title: Overnight flush below $62,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell to $61,946 at 01:45 UTC Sunday, about 29% below its Oct. 2 high of $87,249, before rebounding to around $64,700 by early morning (Coindaro).

themes.title: About $2 billion in liquidations
themes.summary: Roughly $2.05 billion to $2.12 billion of futures positions were liquidated over 24 hours, more than 90% of them long bets, and aggregate bitcoin open interest fell nearly 10% to about $106 billion (CoinGlass and Cryptoast, via Coindaro).

themes.title: Sentiment hits extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to 10, from 13 a day earlier and 28 a week ago (TokenPost).

themes.title: Bitcoin down 14% on the week
themes.summary: Bitcoin was down 14.3% over seven days and ether 18.9%, with Solana down 20.4%, as of early Sunday (Coindaro).

themes.title: Macro pressure from Fed hike bets
themes.summary: Hot October inflation data lifted Fed hike expectations, with futures pricing 64 basis points of increases over the next year, up from 37 at the start of November (crypto.news); a December hike is widely expected heading into a week with Nvidia earnings and Fed minutes (Reuters via Yahoo Finance).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down about 4% and ether about 5.3% over 24 hours as of 06:00 UTC (CoinCodex).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: BNB near $590 (-3.8%), XRP near $0.954 (-3.6%), Solana near $70.21 (-6.2%), Dogecoin near $0.0577 (-7.7%) and TRON near $0.307 (-1.4%) over 24 hours (Koin Bülteni).

categories.name: Small-cap gainers
categories.note: Among the top 200 coins, Zano, Ultima and Midnight rose against the broader decline (CoinCodex).

categories.name: Derivatives
categories.note: Long positions made up most of roughly $2 billion in 24-hour liquidations, with about $800 million on Binance; bitcoin funding rates were near flat across major exchanges (Coindaro).

watch_list.why: Glassnode flags a liquidation cluster between $59,500 and $62,600, which contains Sunday's low; the 2026 low on Coinbase is $57,718 from July 1 (Coindaro).

watch_list.topic: ETF flows when U.S. markets reopen
watch_list.why: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.91 billion of net outflows over seven sessions from Nov. 5 to 13 (crypto.news); flow figures resume Monday, Nov. 16 (Coindaro).

watch_list.topic: Nvidia earnings, Fed minutes and the Anthropic IPO
watch_list.why: Nvidia reports Tuesday, minutes from the Oct. 27-28 Fed meeting are due Wednesday, and Anthropic is expected to debut on Nasdaq Thursday (Stockopedia; Coindaro).

movers.name: Zano (ZANO)
movers.note: Top 24-hour gainer among the top 200 coins (CoinCodex).

movers.name: Aster (ASTER)
movers.note: The weakest of the top 200 coins over 24 hours (CoinCodex).
